item.title: Free Bus Scheme Boosts Pilgrim Footfall at Hasanamba Shrine, Says Legislator
item.description: A Member of the Legislative Council attributed the rising number of visitors at the Hasanamba Temple located in Hassan to the government's Shakti initiative. The program has reportedly contributed to higher attendance at the religious site.

item.title: Congress Leader to Fund Biopic on Sonia Gandhi in Telugu
item.description: Politician Jagga Reddy from the Congress party has revealed intentions to make a Telugu feature film centered on Sonia Gandhi's life. He has pledged financial assistance worth ₹2 crore towards the cinematic project.

item.title: Hikers in Tirupati Choose Sky Lanterns Over Pyrotechnics for Diwali
item.description: Members of the Tirupati Adventure Addicts group observed Diwali by launching floating paper lamps instead of setting off crackers. The illuminated lanterns were launched from a nearby mountain peak, offering visibility to onlookers at the summit and across the urban plain.

item.title: Brazilian Election Panel Penalizes Meta While Clearing It of Intentional Bias
item.description: Following a formal grievance by President Lula's political coalition, Brazil's electoral tribunal imposed a financial penalty on Meta. However, authorities found no proof that the tech giant tried to manipulate the vote. Meta maintained the claims were unfounded and vowed to fight them.

item.title: BJP Parliamentarian Criticizes Sonia Gandhi Over Past Political Roles

item.title: England Women Scrap Caribbean Test Match to Focus on Domestic Ashes Prep
item.description: The English women's cricket team has called off a planned Test match in the West Indies scheduled for April. The team will instead host red-ball fixtures on home soil to train for the upcoming Women's Ashes series.

item.title: Indian Government Sanctions ₹3,230 Crore for Major Heritage Museum Project

Authorities stated the initiative aims to present the country's civilizational history alongside its diverse physical and traditions-based cultural wealth within a unified exhibition.

item.title: Critics call for reforms to AIIB grievance redress system

item.title: Indian cricketer Arshdeep Singh gets engaged to actor Samreen Kaur

item.title: JetBlue to showcase new first-class seating as part of profitability strategy
